description: This Java class 'ShardRegions' manages creation and retrieval of Akka cluster sharding proxy actors for different shard regions, specifically for policies, things, and connections within a distributed system.

classes.name: ShardRegions
classes.description: A utility class for managing Akka cluster sharding proxies for different shard regions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ShardRegions instance with specified ActorSystem and ClusterConfig.

methods.name: policies
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the policies shard region proxy.

methods.name: things
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the things shard region proxy.

methods.name: connections
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the connections shard region proxy.

methods.name: startProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region proxy ActorRef for a given shard region name and cluster role.
